semiconductor_relevance: High — ABM, Inc. Asia Pacific Limited is a significant player in the semiconductor industry, providing essential lithography systems and process equipment for front-end manufacturing.
summary: ABM, Inc. Asia Pacific Limited specializes in the manufacturing of advanced lithography systems and process equipment, crucial for semiconductor front-end manufacturing. The company offers a range of products including proximity/contact lithography machines, coat/develop equipment, and bonding equipment, supporting sectors such as MEMS, power devices, and optical communications.
capabilities: Micro-nano optical devices for CPO applications

regional_presence.China: ABM plans to participate in SEMICON China 2026 in Shanghai, indicating a strategic focus on the Chinese market.
